front.title: A YANG Data Model for Reporting Sensing Utilization Score

abstract.t:
This document defines a YANG data model to report a Sensing Utilization Score (US) for sensing workloads. The US is an abstract, normalized score (0..100) that summarizes the relative resource cost of executing a sensing operation on a device.
The model supports a mandatory overall US and optional explanatory component impact scores (compute, memory, energy, storage, latency). The model also supports optional metadata (e.g., timestamp, aggregation window, and scoring method identification) describing how a reported score was derived.
The model includes a companion augmentation module that attaches sensing utilization telemetry to a GREEN Energy Object, as defined by the GREEN Power and Energy YANG Module, for correlation with power and energy telemetry.
